overview_description.description:
OwnLocal offers an AI platform that automatically converts offline advertising and other data sources into online marketing campaigns.

The OwnLocal platform collects, augments and transforms data into digital marketing campaigns. Best know for their automated online display solution, Origami, OwnLocal products power digital campaigns for over 4000 media companies worldwide, and the private OwnLocal ad network delivers over 10 billion impressions monthly.

OwnLocal was founded in 2010 and is based in Austin, Texas.

product.name: Origami
product.description: An interactive digital advertising platform that converts offline ads into online campaigns to generate leads and extend audience reach for local media publishers.

product.name: Local Directory
product.description: An online directory that creates and updates SEO-optimized landing and profile pages from print ad content to improve advertiser visibility in search engines.

product.name: Powerful Analytics
product.description: A reporting tool that supports OwnLocal’s products by providing data insights to demonstrate digital advertising value and guide advertisers in their marketing decisions.

product.name: AI Platform for Hyperlocal News
product.description: An AI-driven platform that enables journalists to scale hyperlocal news production efficiently.
